tasks.title: THE EXPECTED PARCEL
tasks.prompt: Which parcel was expected at the Demo Desk, and what did it contain?
tasks.explanation: EX-01 expects parcel PX-14 containing the sensor module at the Demo Desk.

tasks.title: WHAT JOEL RECEIVED
tasks.explanation: RC-01 records stage clips in PX-41 at the Demo Desk, with the expected sensor module absent.
reference_sql: SELECT parcel_id,contents_observed FROM sql05_receipts WHERE receipt_id='RC-01'

tasks.title: NOT A COURIER MIX-UP
tasks.prompt: What most strongly shows this was not simply a courier mix-up?

options.text: Reciprocal parcel-code changes on both labels by the same actor before dispatch

tasks.explanation: The audit shows both parcel codes changed in opposite directions by the same actor before dispatch.
reference_sql: SELECT parcel_id,event_at,actor_id,old_value,new_value FROM sql05_label_audit WHERE field_changed='PARCEL_CODE' ORDER BY event_at

tasks.title: WHY IT SAYS DELIVERED
tasks.prompt: Why does the dashboard say PX-14 was delivered even though the module did not reach the Demo Desk?

options.text: The route system follows the swapped label and does not verify contents
The module was confirmed at the Demo Desk

tasks.explanation: The scanner reads labels, not contents, so the dashboard follows the swapped label.
reference_sql: SELECT parcel_id,scan_location,scan_type,scanned_label_destination,note FROM sql05_route_scans ORDER BY event_at

tasks.title: WHO CHANGED THE LABELS
tasks.prompt: Who performed the reciprocal label changes?
tasks.evidence_label: The label changes were made by: {value}
tasks.explanation: Both reciprocal PARCEL_CODE changes (LA-02, LA-03) name Ravi.
reference_sql: SELECT actor_id,parcel_id,event_at,old_value,new_value FROM sql05_label_audit ORDER BY event_at

tasks.title: THE BEST EXPLANATION
tasks.prompt: Which explanation best fits the full record?

options.text: Ravi swapped the labels to route the sensor module to storage until he found its calibration sheet, relying on label-based delivery status to obscure the mismatch.
Sana made a random courier mistake
Joel replaced the module after receiving it
The scanner verified contents and confirmed the module at the desk

tasks.explanation: The swap, the route result and Ravi’s calibration-sheet message together point to a deliberate swap meant to buy time.
reference_sql: SELECT sent_at,sender_id,message_text FROM sql05_messages ORDER BY sent_at
